description: One byte past the 64 KiB limit for a response body — this is a provider-side internal-consistency check (§6's limit applies to both directions), surfaced as answer_validation_failed or temporarily_unavailable rather than request_too_large, since request_too_large is specifically the REQUEST-side code (§17).
note: The parsed document is schema-valid as a response; only its raw byte length exceeds the ceiling. Unlike the request side, RC2's error table has no response-body-specific code — this vector proves the SIZE fact only, not which of Prime's own internal failure codes it should surface as.
